title: MongoDB Agent OTLP - Backend Diff
description: Side-by-side drift comparison: LEFT = prometheus (dedicated receiver), RIGHT = grafana-otel (Grafana backend). The agent exports to both simultaneously - the same panel on both sides should show the same shape. Divergence means one backend dropped or lagged data. Fully label-driven like the source dashboard.

options.content:
**LEFT: `prometheus` (dedicated receiver)**  |  **RIGHT: `grafana-otel` (Grafana backend)**

Same agent, two export slots, same queries - rows align horizontally for scroll comparison. A shape difference between the two sides is ingestion drift.

panels.title: WiredTiger cache (per process)  ◀ prom
panels.description: up-down counters, point-in-time bytes. On an idle deployment used/dirty creep up slowly (MB/h) - that is the agent's own polling loading catalog pages plus mongod session housekeeping; checkpoints reset dirty periodically. Only a concern when used approaches total or dirty grows unbounded between checkpoints.

targets.expr: sum by (server_address, server_port) (mongodb_wtcache_bytes_used * on(instance) group_left(server_address, server_port, mongodb_replica_set) (max by (instance, server_address, server_port, mongodb_replica_set) (target_info{mongodb_process_type=~"mongod|mongos"})))
